entities.summary: Serhiy Danylchenko is a retired Ukrainian boxer, who won a Bantamweight Bronze medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics. On the way to his bronze medal, Danylchenko got a 1st round bye, and defeated India's Dingko Singh and Australia's Justin Kane, before losing in the semifinal against Russia's Raimkul Malakhbekov.
